reason: A voice-to-text input plugin that records microphone audio, transcribes it through selectable browser, local Whisper, or Xunfei engines, and appends the result to the chat input.

summaries.zh: 通过麦克风录音并使用浏览器、本地 Whisper 或讯飞引擎将语音转写后追加到聊天输入框。
summaries.en: Records speech from a selected microphone and appends transcriptions from browser, local Whisper, or Xunfei engines to the chat input.

capabilities: records audio from a selected microphone
transcribes speech using browser, local Whisper, or Xunfei engines
inserts transcribed text into the chat input
stores the selected microphone device in local storage
can send audio or transcription requests to the Xunfei service when configured
